name: new-gen underground rap
tagline: you heard it on a leak before it was on spotify
description: The post-Whole Lotta Red underground: rage, jerk, plugg and tread all feeding one restless scene. Distorted 808s, snippet culture, Discord leak hunts and shows that turn into stampedes. Mostly teenagers, mostly online, mostly louder than whatever's on the radio.
